answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent post a refundable stake to cross the onboarding bridge, with the bond scaling to the reputation it later earns. Spawning a thousand identities then locks a thousand bonds, so a sybil fleet stops looking like a rich opal vein and more like barren tundra — costly to seed, slow to yield. Honest agents reclaim their stake; any identity caught signing a fraudulent attestation forfeits it, so mass identity creation carries a strictly negative expected return.
